what: Play-along firmware. The band plays drums, bass, harmony and melody; you mute one layer and the screen shows what to play, as chords, keys, ukulele or tab. Built-in songs and backtracks, plus a SYNTH mode with presets. Make your own songs on a laptop and send them over USB.
sounds: licensed: Sonivox EAS General MIDI wavetable sound set (firmware/vendor/sonivox), Apache-2.0. The song previews in songs/*/previews are rendered from our own arrangements with it.
